field_mapping.alert_id: Unique alert reference. Deterministic, so re-running does not duplicate cases.
field_mapping.entity_type: Always ACCOUNT. This model scores accounts, not customers or transactions.
field_mapping.entity_ref: Account reference as supplied. Row index where the source is anonymised.
field_mapping.risk_probability: Calibrated probability that the account is a mule, 0-1.
field_mapping.priority: 1 = highest. Derived from the band, for queue ordering.
field_mapping.risk_band: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH. Edges are fitted operating points, not fixed constants.
field_mapping.scenario_codes: Typology codes that fired. OUR taxonomy, not a regulator code list.
field_mapping.scenario_names: Plain-language typology names for the codes above.
field_mapping.scenario_detail: Per-code MEASURED lift and precision on this dataset, so a receiving system can weight scenarios rather than treating them as equally meaningful. Seven of ours score at or below the base rate and say so.
field_mapping.recommended_action: Suggested disposition. Advisory only; a human decides.
field_mapping.reasons: Ranked feature attributions with direction and magnitude.
field_mapping.model_id / model_version: Provenance, for model risk management and audit.
field_mapping.score_provenance: Whether the score is out-of-fold or from the deployed model.
field_mapping.data_integrity_warning: Present when the source dataset failed its integrity audit.

typology_taxonomy.R11: Pure conduit, net flow near zero
typology_taxonomy.ML: Model-derived behavioural risk (no single rule fired)

compatibility_statement: Vendor-neutral export. NOT certified against any named EFRMS or AML product; no such testing has been performed. Integration is a field mapping exercise against the schema documented in field_mapping.
what_would_be_needed_for_a_named_platfor: A scenario catalogue to map scenario_codes onto.
An agreed entity key, since this dataset is anonymised.
A test environment to validate ingestion against.
